يمتزج (form VIII)
# يَمْتَزِجُ (yamtaziju) /jam.ta.zi.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# يُمْتَزَجُ (yumtazaju) /jum.ta.za.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# يَمْتَزِجَ (yamtazija) /jam.ta.zi.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
